overview.headline: Ship clear documentation and project overviews without frontend build bloat.
overview.summary: Open Workbench Starter gives maintainers a clean static site with a focused overview page, a two-column Markdown docs reader, and shared navigation across sibling tools.

quickstart_steps.title: 1 — Copy Starter Folder
quickstart_steps.body: Duplicate this starter folder once and fill in your spelled-out project title and Markdown guides.

quickstart_steps.title: 2 — Build Static Routes
quickstart_steps.body: Compile Overview, Docs, and your 1280x640 preview image with zero JavaScript build steps.

quickstart_steps.title: 3 — Ship Anywhere
quickstart_steps.body: Publish static HTML, CSS tokens, and vector diagrams to GitHub Pages or any web host.

plain_language_blocks.title: One Manifest, Predictable Routes
plain_language_blocks.body: Keep project metadata, sibling switcher links, and navigation routes in a single validated JSON manifest with zero hidden build config.

plain_language_blocks.title: Plain Markdown Documentation
plain_language_blocks.body: Write guides in ordinary Markdown files and render them into a fast, keyboard-accessible reader with section links and quick jumps.

plain_language_blocks.title: Offline-Ready Static Output
plain_language_blocks.body: Emit self-contained HTML, CSS, and vector diagrams that deploy cleanly to any static host across four readable light and dark themes.
